choose.when: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM xsy_payment_refund p JOIN xsy_payment_intent i ON i.id = p.intent_id AND i.deleted = FALSE WHERE p.id = #{paymentRefundId} AND p.source_type = 'ORDER_REFUND' AND p.source_id = #{refundId} AND p.deleted = FALSE AND p.status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND i.customer_id = #{customerId} AND p.amount = #{amount} AND p.provider_amount = #{amount})
choose.otherwise: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 AND COALESCE(SUM(a.allocated_amount), 0) = #{amount} AND COALESCE(BOOL_AND(a.status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND a.customer_id = #{customerId} AND CASE WHEN a.source_method = 'ONLINE' THEN p.id IS NOT NULL AND p.status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND p.source_type = 'REFUND_FUNDING_ALLOCATION' AND p.source_id = a.id AND p.transaction_id = a.source_id AND p.amount = a.allocated_amount AND p.provider_amount = a.allocated_amount ELSE m.id IS NOT NULL AND m.type = 'REFUND' AND m.direction = 'CREDIT' AND m.source_type = 'REFUND_FUNDING_ALLOCATION' AND m.source_id = a.id AND m.customer_id = a.customer_id AND m.settlement_customer_id = a.settlement_customer_id AND m.amount = a.allocated_amount END), FALSE) FROM xsy_refund_funding_allocation a LEFT JOIN xsy_payment_refund p ON a.source_method = 'ONLINE' AND p.id = a.result_source_id AND p.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN xsy_customer_balance_movement m ON a.source_method = 'BALANCE' AND m.id = a.result_source_id AND m.deleted = FALSE WHERE a.order_refund_id = #{refundId} AND a.deleted = FALSE

mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM xsy_refund_funding_allocation WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND deleted = FALSE)

SELECT r.id AS refundId, r.order_id AS orderId, r.customer_id AS customerId, CASE WHEN r.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS completed, r.refund_amount AS refundAmount FROM xsy_order_refund r WHERE r.id = #{refundId} AND r.deleted = FALSE

SELECT r.id AS refundId, r.order_id AS orderId, r.customer_id AS customerId, CASE WHEN r.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS completed, r.refund_amount AS refundAmount FROM xsy_order_refund r WHERE r.id = #{refundId} AND r.deleted = FALSE FOR UPDATE

SELECT r.id AS refundId, r.refund_no AS refundNo, rt.return_no AS returnNo, o.order_no AS orderNo, r.customer_id AS customerId, c.name AS customerName, r.refund_amount AS refundAmount, r.completed_at AS completedAt FROM xsy_order_refund r JOIN xsy_customer c ON c.id = r.customer_id AND c.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN xsy_order_return rt ON rt.id = r.return_id AND rt.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN xsy_sales_order o ON o.id = r.order_id AND o.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN xsy_finance_payment p ON p.source_type = 'ORDER_REFUND' AND p.source_id = r.id AND p.entry_type = 'NORMAL' AND p.deleted = FALSE WHERE r.deleted = FALSE AND r.status = 'COMPLETED' AND p.id IS NULL
AND FALSE
AND FALSE
AND c.seller_id IN #{sellerId}
AND (r.refund_no ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(rt.return_no, '') ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(o.order_no, '') ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR c.name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY r.completed_at DESC, r.id DESC
SELECT r.id FROM xsy_payment_refund r WHERE r.source_type = 'ORDER_REFUND' AND r.source_id = #{orderRefundId} AND r.deleted = FALSE LIMIT 1
